description: Reads an Obsidian vault's Excalidraw schemes by meaning and draws them safely.
name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-obsidian

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_OBSIDIAN_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault root; "Path" in ~/.config/s3l-mcp-obsidian/config.json when not set.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_OBSIDIAN_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: The settings file to read, the only one read when set; otherwise the first that exists of the chain every Snail MCP server reads.
